en.title: CNK-FarmaStatR · P1 prototype
en.subtitle: In vitro equivalence simulation (FDA PBE and EMA OIP) · webR in the browser
en.disclaimer: For research and education; not a system validated for GxP environments.
en.proto_note: P1 minimal prototype: rates are not classified by hypothesis state; all are shown as "probability of BE acceptance" (FSR-TN-PLT-01 v0.4, D-05).
en.st_cancelled: Cancelled; no result produced. Restarting the engine…
en.st_cancelled_ready: Cancelled; no result produced. The engine is ready again.
en.st_blocked: Computation blocked: an engine file could not be verified.
en.hash_missing: File not in the validation list
en.row_fda_pass: FDA PBE · probability of BE acceptance
en.row_fda_cover: FDA · coverage of η by the upper bound
en.err_delta0: FDA δ₀ is not defined for this σR and ρ (η is already positive at δ = 0).
en.code_integer_min_2: {f} must be a whole number of at least 2.
en.code_integer_min_1: {f} must be a whole number of at least 1.
en.code_n_sim_range: nsim must be a whole number between 1 and 20,000.
en.code_seed_integer: seed must be a whole number in the R integer range.
en.code_ema_limits_order: EMA limits must satisfy 0 < lower < 1 < upper.
en.code_duplicate_param: A parameter is given more than once.
en.code_params_not_named_list: Parameters must be a named list.
